name: openapi-codegen
description: Generates web/src/lib/api/generated from api/openapi.yaml. Hey API 0.99.0 needs the TypeScript compiler API, which TypeScript 7 no longer has (hey-api/hey-api#4235), so this package takes Microsoft's @typescript/typescript6 under the name typescript, as VS Code, Grafana, Immich's docs and AFFiNE's tools do, while web/ uses TypeScript 7. Remove it once Hey API supports TypeScript 7.
